mediaWork.title: Broken Justice
mediaWork.creatorName: Amna Nawaz, Frank Carlson, Vika Aronson
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Examines the crisis in Missouri's public defender system through the wrongful conviction of Ricky Kidd.
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Limited investigative podcast from PBS NewsHour examining how chronically underfunded, overworked public defense systems contribute to wrongful convictions, told through the 23-year wrongful imprisonment and eventual 2019 exoneration of Ricky Kidd in Kansas City, Missouri.
mediaWork.availabilityNotes: Apple Podcasts · Public RSS feed verified · ~9 episodes on Apple Podcasts
